menu.home.tip.menu: Right Shift opens this menu from anywhere.
menu.home.tip.zoom: Hold C to zoom. Turn on Scroll zoom to change the level with the wheel.
menu.home.tip.freelook: Hold V to look around without turning your character.
menu.home.tip.crosshair: Crosshair > Custom crosshair picks one of nine styles. The preview is live.
menu.home.tip.keystrokes: Keystrokes shows your movement keys on the HUD. Turn it on in Modules > HUD.
menu.settings.menu_key_hint: Change it in Options > Controls > Confu Client.
